notes.integrity: source_revision and artifact_sha256 are separate fields. artifact_sha256 is populated only from actual downloaded bytes and is never substituted with a git SHA or package version.
notes.triposr_usage: Commercial profile requires the pinned TripoSR source commit.
notes.anime_face_detector_usage: Package version is pinned exactly in pyproject.toml.
notes.vrm_export: VRM 1.0 is emitted by the pure-Python pygltflib path; Blender/VRM Add-on is not a runtime dependency.
notes.torchmcubes_usage: Install after PyTorch and build dependencies with --no-build-isolation; native build parallelism is capped for Colab.
notes.runtime_contract: Colab runtime v6 pins the direct compatibility packages recorded here. artifact_sha256 stays null unless exact installed wheel bytes are captured and trusted.
notes.transitive_scope: commercial_safe flags cover the direct locked components; installed transitive distributions must still be audited from the resolved environment.
notes.triposr_model_integrity: The Hugging Face model revision is pinned separately from the TripoSR source revision; model.ckpt bytes are verified against model_weight_sha256 before inference.
notes.gradio_usage: Colab notebook pins Gradio exactly; the published wheel SHA256 is recorded separately from observed artifact_sha256.
notes.dino_runtime_pin: Upstream TripoSR requests facebook/dino-vitb16 config.json without revision; the local deterministic runner forces this immutable revision.
notes.rembg_model_integrity: rembg 2.0.85 verifies u2net.onnx with the locked MD5; the pipeline removes MODEL_CHECKSUM_DISABLED from the TripoSR subprocess environment.
